title: Hunts FH-044T: Import doors, a player's earlier-edition record, and one pilot release walk

source.ref: Split from FH-044S (2026-11-20): the grace rule and the editor release shipped; the screens below and the operator walk remain.

detail: Owed after FH-044S. (1) Web: the import doors. A Regulars hunt from its host Space's hunts screen, and a QR campaign from /admin/qr, call importRegularsHuntAction / importQrCampaignAction in app/(main)/hunts/edition-actions.ts and show the notices; today nothing calls them. (2) Web: on the Trail page, show a player their run on an earlier edition (loadRunRecord) and their old rewards (readOldGrants). runStanding in lib/hunts/editions.ts still calls an in-grace run a record; pass it editionGraceEndsAt so a run inside its 7 days reads as playing. (3) Operator: walk one pilot Trail through a release with real printed codes and confirm each old code opens the right stop, and that a run started before the release can still finish for 7 days. Done when: both import doors call their actions and the Trail page reads loadRunRecord. Requires: FH-044S. Owner role: Web.
